typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CURRENT_MCP as string,
		MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		PCP_ADDRESS as string,
		PCP_PHONE as string,
		PCP_ID as string,
		PCP_NPI as string,
		PCP_TIN as string,
		PROVIDER_CPC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	MEMBER_ID  	,MEMBER_LNAME	 	,MEMBER_FNAME	 	,MEMBER_DOB	 	,PCP_NAME    	,PCP_ADDRESS 	,PCP_PHONE 	,PCP_ID 	,PCP_NPI 	,PCP_TIN  	,PROVIDER_CPC 	,CURRENT_MCP from [Data_Exchange].[EXTRACT].[OH_TOC_Extract]  ##OH_TOC_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT
SourceTableOHTOCEXTRACT split(locate('CARESOURCE', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('MOLINA', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('BUCKEYE', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('UNITED', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('AMERIHEALTH', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('HUMANA', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1,locate('AETNA', CURRENT_MCP, 1) == 1, disjoint: true) ~> SplitDatabasedonMCP@(CARESOURCE,MOLINA,BUCKEYE,UNITED,AMERIHEALTH,HUMANA,AETNA,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
SplitDatabasedonMCP@CARESOURCE sink(input(
		PCP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		PCP_PHONE as string,
		PCP_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		PCP_TIN as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		PCP_NPI as string,
		PROVIDER_CPC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PCP_ID,
		MEMBER_FNAME,
		PCP_PHONE,
		PCP_ADDRESS,
		MEMBER_ID,
		MEMBER_LNAME,
		PCP_TIN,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		PCP_NAME,
		PCP_NPI,
		PROVIDER_CPC)) ~> FlatFileCareSourcePCP
